stops.quote: fixes on poor work passed off as sound

tawdry.oewn-02354846-s.why: A learner reads *fixes* as repairs and *sound* as a noise, and *passed off as* and *written off whole* are idioms whose plain words leave them with nothing.

unreformable.oewn-02524877-s.why: *Take* here means succeed or hold, a sense the learner cannot get from the plain word, so the first half of the note says nothing to them.
